clusters.mechanism: Switching a provider to quota="unlimited" suppresses new window alerts (early return in observeWindows) but never clears or filters previously persisted window alerts, so they stay active after restart/refreshAlerts, indefinitely when resetsAt is null.
The quota schema default of "windows" and resolveCatalog normalisation make `providers export` write `quota = "windows"` for every provider, adding churn with a default value.
Pre-existing, unrelated git-integrity config-cache test fails with an extra config scan.
The MCP providers tool output schema (non-passthrough zod object) lacks a quota key, so the new quota field is stripped from MCP output.
